turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So I wore a dress once to a dinner and now I kind of hate it. Can I return it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That depends on the shop's policy, but honestly, most only take back clothes that are unworn with the tags still on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The tags are off. I cut them off in the car.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then a normal return is unlikely. Some places will still offer store credit if it looks brand new, it doesn't hurt to ask politely.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's fine to ask, as long as you're honest that you wore it. Don't pretend otherwise, staff can usually tell.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And if they say no?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then sell it on a resale app or swap it with a friend. A once worn dress is a nice find for someone else.
